title: Megurine Luka — Being There〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can all keep going, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's so cool how they're all in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right?! They're all really good and work in perfect sync!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That must be the result of all their hard work.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all, they needed to practice in order to help Ichika and the others after they set out to become professional musicians.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've been working so hard. I hope you've been taking breaks here and there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I have.
I know what fatigue does to your concentration, so I'm being careful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, you seem to be going about things somewhat differently compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is it because the girls decided to go pro together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How they're going to pursue that goal is entirely up to them, but one simple fact is that they'll need to become better performers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're very lucky to have you as their senior.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And we'll need to follow suit since we're in the same shoes as you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Miku, why don't the three of us have a quick session?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right! That SEKAI's me, Rin and KAITO hadn't arrived yet, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin was the final piece necessary to have their band mirror the girls'.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That SEKAI's Miku seemed so happy about having a fourth person join them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we play with the same instruments as the girls? It'd be great to play the songs they've been practicing too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That does sound like fun♪
Nice idea, Miku-P!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would that be alright, Luka, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
Count us in, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I love how Miku's nickname is Miku-P♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That reminds me of when you copied her for a little while, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, Miku got on board right away and even started calling me Rin-P.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. The way you two talked that time was so adorable.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, after Rin, KAITO and I arrived.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: With regards to that SEKAI, the fight Rin and Len had left a very big impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I remember that! He became worried that she was practicing way too hard, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, and I think it was necessary for the two of them to hash things out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But I wasn't actually that worried.
After all, MEIKO stepped in to mediate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? I seem to recall a certain someone asking me to go see what was happening because he wanted to know but was too afraid to go himself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uhh... Isn't it great to be able to tell others how you really feel?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I think they're back to playing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are they practicing their next song?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All six of them have been working so hard as a band. I don't think there's been a day when no one played anything since they all came together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, and I feel like singing back every time I hear them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope we get to have a little session with them someday.
